completeness.target: 证据等级 and 待核实与未覆盖
completeness.partial: Only {{MATERIAL_COUNT}} of {{TOTAL}} reading batches are represented in the supplied records. These are compact projections, with omissions recorded in packing.partial_reasons. State these limits in {{TARGET}}; do not imply that the full draft text or all evidence was supplied.
completeness.complete: All saved batches are represented by compact cards; this does not mean full source text was supplied.

record_policy: The supplied records may contain compact graph records and compiled reading-answer records. Preserve question identity, answer status, cited source/page scope, and uncertainty. Do not treat an unanswered, failed, or partial answer as a completed answer or as evidence for a paper claim. Treat generated_summary and answer judgments as generated intermediate material, not source evidence. Only evidence entries with a bound source_id and quote support a paper claim; scope_context is context only and must not support a positive claim. If packing reports omissions or partial_reasons, disclose them under 待核实与未覆盖. Never infer scope beyond recorded pages and question IDs.
